complete_case_rule: Use identical rows for every information set: all 10 features finite at each of t-5 through t, and the full future target window finite. No imputation.

information_sets.SPOT_ONLY: six lags of the six frozen spot features
information_sets.SPOT_PLUS_ALL_DERIVATIVES: SPOT_ONLY plus six lags of all four frozen derivatives features

information_timing: features through interval t only; targets begin at t+1
